notes.title: The Cross Horror Game Release Announcement
notes.notes:
I’m proud to announce that “[b]The Cross Horror Game[/b]”  Coming to Steam on [b]31-july-2019. [/b]
 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117120/The_Cross_Horror_Game/


The Cross is an addictive first-person survival 3D horror game 

The Cross is a survival horror game designed for Pc. The game follows zak as he searches for his missing daughter lilly and his wife after accident in the s.street Florida.  You find yourself stuck in a weird dark scarry haunted house which is infested with zombies, ghost, monsters, witches, and demons.

	The Powerful Unreal Enigne 4 Create Amazing 3D High End Graphics with Interesting Game Play and Stunning Haunted Horror Atmosphere.


Watch the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LEOGW0VshFo&t=10s


We would love for you to add your voice to the The Cross Horror Game Steam Community!
